text:
Ravi: Quick note 2m3 - I'm landing a micro-PR to clean up the hello-world quickstart: remove duplicate auth snippet, standardize env var to REDWOOD_API_KEY, and add a tiny smoke-check after deploy. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3333
Mae: Nice. Can you also normalize the JS sample to use the new SDK shape? Right now it mixes `new Redwood()` and `new RedwoodClient()`.
Hannah: I noticed the Node example is missing an `await` before `client.generate()` which causes unhandled promise rejections in the sample app CI. Small fix.
Build Bot: docs-ci started for PR #3333  running build + linkcheck + examples-smoke.
Ravi: Pushed fixes: switched env var to REDWOOD_API_KEY everywhere, updated JS to `new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })`, and added `curl` health check snippet at the end.
Docs QA: linkcheck flagged one external link to the deploy FAQ; looks like the target moved. Recommend switching to the canonical /deploy/faq/ path or adding a redirect.
Mae: Approved the code changes. Left one tiny nit to clarify the CLI `--region` example (suggest `--region eu-west-1` in the note).
Build Bot: examples-smoke reported: health check returned 200. Linkcheck still shows deploy FAQ redirect missing.
Ravi: Merging after I open a follow-up issue for the redirect and tag infra. Thanks for the quick reviews! :tada:
